purpose: Screenwriting as versioned creative labor connecting story design, shootable scenes, production revisions, adaptation, and formal credit.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name the script version and jurisdiction. Distinguish contribution from formal credit, and written intention from decisions made in performance, camera, and edit.
